climateNote: This is a volcanic-system event: bradyseism — pressurization of the caldera's hydrothermal/magmatic system — drives the uplift. No climate connection is claimed.

dataset.mission: Sentinel-1A/1B (Copernicus), ascending pass; COSMO-SkyMed in published INGV studies
dataset.datasetId: INGV Osservatorio Vesuviano deformation bulletins (RITE GNSS, InSAR); Copernicus Sentinel-1 SLC
dataset.window: Published: 2005–2025 bradyseism record; in-app pass-pair window: 360 days (Dec 2025 rate)
dataset.coverage: Campi Flegrei caldera — Pozzuoli and Naples metropolitan edge (~24 km scene)
dataset.gnss: FRUL, Nevada Geodetic Lab daily IGS20 solutions, bundled as weekly means
dataset.processing: Published: INGV OV GNSS + InSAR monitoring bulletins. In-app: elastic Mogi point source at 3.5 km depth; one fringe = λ/2 line-of-sight motion

items.label: MEASURED
items.detail: Real daily IGS20 solutions from NGL station FRUL, downsampled to weekly means, bundled and charted in-app.

items.label: MEASURED
items.detail: ~25 mm/mo uplift (Dec 2025, INGV OV); >1 m cumulative uplift at Pozzuoli since 2005 (RITE GNSS). Shown as citations; not re-derived in-app.

items.label: MODELED
items.detail: Physics rendering of an elastic Mogi source (0.0154 km³ at 3.5 km depth). NOT a raw SAR image — computed on-device.

items.label: DERIVED
items.detail: Computed on-device from the physical model (one fringe = λ/2 LOS). Tracks the model, not a downloaded product.

items.label: LIVE
items.detail: Live accelerometer from the demo ESP32 ground station — IoT demo at the demo site; not a satellite measurement of this event.

limitations: The interferogram is a physics rendering of published figures, not raw SAR pixels — no SAR processing is done in-app.
Bradyseism involves both magmatic and hydrothermal pressurization; a single Mogi source is a simplification.
Civil-safety interpretation is INGV's and the Civil Protection Department's domain, not this app's.
